caritas-urology.overviewHeading: Where Healing and Innovation Unite in Orthopaedic Excellence.
overviewParagraphs: Urology treatment in India is one of the most popular and demanded medical tourism packages. It is the branch of medicine concerned with the genitourinary system and deals with severe ailments like kidney disease, urinary tract infections, bladder dysfunction, erectile dysfunction and others. People from different countries come to India for affordable urology and urologic oncology treatment, which includes prostate cancer surgery and bladder cancer surgery. Caritas has achieved the name of the best urology hospital in Kerala, which is equipped with highly experienced specialists and state-of-the-art facilities. These facilities enable us at Caritas to carry forward the legacy of India being one of the most sought-after destinations for affordable urology treatments.

Over the years, we have reinstated our position as the best urology hospital in Kerala by being at the top of the latest innovations and technological refinements in the field of urological care. With our team of highly trained urologists, we provide state-of-the-art diagnostic services to all our patients. Our urologists are backed by many support staff dedicated to providing high-quality care, excellent service and personal attention to each patient.

caritas-ent-audiology.overviewHeading: Harmonizing Sound, Enhancing Lives: Your Ear and Throat Health, Our Priority
overviewParagraphs: The Department of Otorhinolaryngology (ENT) at the Caritas Hospital offers comprehensive care for all disorders related to the ear, nose, and throat. The Department is one of the best centers in Central Travancore providing:

Audiology and speech –language pathology is designed to provide for the development of advanced knowledge and skills related to the professions that specialize in communication disorders, speech language pathology, hearing and speech and language science.

Audiologists treat those with hearing loss and proactively prevent damage. Employing various testing strategies, audiologists aim to determine whether someone has normal sensitivity to sounds. If hearing loss is identified, audiologists determine which portions of hearing are affected, to what degree and where the lesion causing the hearing loss is found. In addition to diagnostic audiologic and vestibular pathologies , audiologists can also specialize in rehabilitation of tinnitus, hyperacusis, auditory processing disordes, cochlear implant use and hearing aid use.

The scope of practice as determined by the American speech-language-hearing association for these professions; multicultural service delivery for individuals with communication disorders; practice settings; employment opportunities; and the use of technology in management and treatment of communication disorders.

interventional-radiology.overviewHeading: Unveiling the Epitome of Precision in Healthcare with the Best Radiology Hospital in Kerala
overviewParagraphs: Caritas Hospital has charted its growth from providing medical care for maternity needs and snakebite management to complex treatment procedures, high-precision surgeries and providing evidence-based treatments. Interventional radiology has played a critical role in this journey. The well-equipped radiology department generates highly-precise and accurate diagnosis that facilitate evidence-based therapy for patients. It earned us the name of the best radiology hospital in Kerala.

Our radiology department has a wide range of state-of-the-art imaging equipment, including digital X-ray, fluoroscopy, CT scan and ultrasound. The department also provides 3D/4D/contrast ultrasound and Doppler/colour doppler imaging. The Radiology Department also houses mammography units for highly-precise breast imaging, multi-slice CT and MRI.

All procedures are performed by highly trained medical professionals dedicated to providing quality care. Our radiology department offers same-day service for all your radiological needs. You can get treated at our hospital without waiting for days or weeks for your appointment. If needed, our radiologists use local anaesthesia during diagnosis & interventional procedures so that you do not feel any pain during the test itself. It means that you will be able to undergo almost any type of test without feeling any discomfort or pain whatsoever.

psychiatry.overviewHeading: Healing Minds, Restoring Lives: Your Path to Mental Wellness
overviewParagraphs: According to a Deloitte survey, mental health issues in India constitute about 15% of the global mental health disorder burden. Such a considerable percentage is mainly attributed to inadequate medical care. This lag in medical care is not because of a lacuna in psychiatric care quality but because of the general stigma associated with mental health issues.

To break this stigma, Caritas Hospital has designed a unique package that offers an inclusive approach towards patients with behavioral or mental health issues. Such an approach invites a massive footfall of care-seekers at our premises, which has eventually helped us become one of the best psychiatry hospitals in Kerala

The psychiatry department at Caritas Hospital is a specialized healthcare institution that provides evidence-based preventive and therapeutic treatment of mental disorders. Our target is to offer quality services in psychiatric care including geriatric and paediatric care with a calm atmosphere, privacy and respect.

pulmonology.overviewHeading: Breathing Life into Health: Your Lungs, Our Expertise.
overviewParagraphs: Findings of the Seasonal Waves Of Respiratory Disorders (SWORD) study stated that chronic and acute respiratory problems are the most significant contributors to India’s growing mortality rate after heart diseases.

The lack of awareness about such morbid conditions has resulted in demography leading to reckless lifestyles and food habits. Such a lifestyle eventually leads to symptoms like chest tightness, sleep apnea, and wheezing that ultimately manifests into severe ailments like lung cancer.

At Caritas, our motto is to relieve a patient from their respiratory problems and educate the masses about the gravity of COPD illnesses and the necessity to lead a healthy lifestyle to remove this disease from its roots.
Over the years, we have successfully achieved the objective that helped us to be identified as the best pulmonology hospital in Kerala.
